track.title: Chahargah: Daramad-e Sevom, Pish Zanguleh va Zanguleh

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gs3 and dwells most on F# in Daramad-e Sevom. Pish Zanguleh (0:14.3) introduces D#, E, centred on B. Zanguleh (0:52.5) introduces A#, centred on B. The line peaks at E4 (332.5 Hz) at 0:42.4. It closes on the tonic (B3 → D#4 → E4 → E4 → A#3 → B2).
